    ProblemDetail:

      type: object
      properties:

          format: uri

        title:

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp

          type: string
          format: date-time

        - type

## Summary

I implemented the `customerCode` assignment rule for `POST /api/owners`. The code is formatted `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` — the upper-cased first three letters of `lastName` and a 4-digit zero-padded global sequence equal to one more than the current owner count.

Changes, following the OfficeFloor function-injection conventions in AGENTS.md:

- **New function step** `AssignCustomerCode.java` — reads the built `@Val Owner`, computes `ownerRepository.findAll().size() + 1` as the sequence, and sets `customerCode` via `String.format("%s-%04d", last3, sequence)`. It runs before `SaveOwner`, so the count reflects existing owners only (each create sees exactly one more than the previous → the test's +1 delta holds). Handles short surnames safely with `Math.min(3, len)`.
- **Wired into** `owners.POST.yml` as a new `assignCode` step between `build` and `save`, under `govern: [ transaction ]` like its neighbors.
- **`Owner` entity** — added the persisted `customerCode` field (`@Column(name = "customer_code")`) with getter/setter, so it survives to the `GET /api/owners/{id}` read-back. MapStruct maps it to the DTO by name automatically.
- **`openapi.yml`** — added `customerCode` as a read-only property on the `Owner` schema (alongside `displayName`/`initials`), so the generated `OwnerDto` carries it.
- **Schema files** — added the `customer_code` column to the owners table in all four DBs (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). The hsqldb (test DB) has `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to be added to `schema.sql`; I also gave the positional `data.sql` owner inserts an explicit column list so the new nullable column doesn't break the seed load.
